ev.q: During 2010–2017, of 327,700 diagnosed HIV infections in the United States, 327,502 (99.94%) were HIV-1
the number of confirmed and probable HIV-2 infections increased by an estimated 12.0% per year
Persons with HIV-2 infection were as likely to be female as male
however, >99.9% of all HIV infections identified in the United States were categorized as HIV-1
Demographic characteristics of persons with HIV-1 infection varied substantially from those with HIV-2 infection
NHSS is a case-based surveillance system for the United States
Use of the HIV-1/HIV-2 differentiation test increased steadily throughout the study period

methods_quotes.q: The estimated annual percentage change ( 7 ) was used to calculate the number of HIV diagnoses
Data from NHSS were used to summarize patient demographics, HIV transmission risk category
